info.name: Telesign Initiate API
info.description:
Operations tagged Initiate across 2 of this provider's published API definitions: telesign-app-verify-api-openapi.json, telesign-silent-verify-api-openapi.json. Each path carries the servers of the definition it was published in.

Contact Support:
 Name: Telesign Customer Support Team
 Email: support@telesign.com

urlencoded.description: (Required) Your end user's phone number, including the country code.
The name of the company providing communication services for the device. This parameter takes the form of a string that can be up to 32 characters long.
The type of connection the device uses, such as WiFi or cellular. This parameter is an integer up to 3 characters long.
The international country code for the carrier for the device. This is an integer that is 3 characters long.
The phone number associated with the device. This parameter is a string that can be up to 32 characters long.
Whether the device is considered to be roaming in the current network, for Global System for Mobile Communications (GSM) purposes. It is an integer that is 1 character long.
Whether the device is capable of sending and receiving voice calls and messages. It is an integer that is 1 character long.
The type of network the device is in. It is an integer that is 3 characters long.
The version of the operating system the device uses.
The version of Android the device uses.

If you choose to specify a code (it should be five digits long), then you would add it to your initiate request as a string as shown in the example. You must have this feature enabled, speak with our Customer Support Team for assistance.
The time in seconds that the handset is going to wait for the verification call to arrive, from the time it receives a successful initiate response. The call time is limited to 45 seconds.

request.description:
Use this endpont to initiate verification of the specified phone number using the Telesign App Verify API.

To add this product to your account, contact a Telesign expert. This product is available for Full-service accounts only.

## General requirements
* **Authentication:** Basic (easiest to implement) and Digest
* **Encoding:** Accepts only UTF-8 encoded unicode characters as inputs
* **Accepts:** `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`
* **Required headers:** `Content-Type - application/x-www-form-urlencoded`
* **Rate limit:** Default rate limits by product

request.description:
Use this action to initiate silent verification of a user via the Telesign Silent Verify API.

**Note:** Before using the sample code on this page, contact the Telesign Customer Support Team. We will walk you through the necessary onboarding steps before you use the service. This product is for full-service accounts only. **Your request must come from a device with a mobile carrier connection.**

## General requirements
* **Authentication:** Basic (easiest to implement) or Digest
* **Encoding:** Accepts only **UTF-8 unicode** characters as inputs.
* **Accepts:** `application/json`
* **Responds with:** `application/json`
* **Rate limit:** Default rate limits by product
